selected_api_response.raw_content:
## reasoning ##
1. The requested target is about 1.00% above the observed 1568.817234 TPS, so the configuration prioritizes reduced commit latency, improved cache residency, and lower per-transaction planning overhead.
2. The previous shared_buffers value was only 16384 blocks (128 MiB), while physical memory utilization was 1.85 GiB and the buffer hit rate was 90.15%; increasing shared_buffers to 1966173 blocks (about 15 GiB) should materially reduce the high read-I/O rate without consuming all 30.82 GiB of RAM.
3. effective_cache_size is set to 3145729 blocks (about 24 GiB) to represent PostgreSQL buffers plus likely operating-system cache while retaining memory headroom for 16 client sessions and background processes.
4. TPC-C is a short, index-oriented OLTP workload, so enable_indexscan remains enabled and the CPU cost constants are adjusted only slightly to avoid destabilizing otherwise appropriate index-based plans.
5. Parallel query normally adds setup, tuple-transfer, and worker-coordination overhead to short TPC-C statements; max_parallel_workers_per_gather is therefore limited to one, force_parallel_mode is disabled, and non-round parallel thresholds and costs discourage unnecessary parallel plans.
6. JIT compilation is disabled because its compilation and planner overhead generally exceeds its execution benefit for short, frequently executed OLTP statements; all subordinate JIT features are also disabled, while non-default thresholds provide consistent fallback settings.
7. Planner, executor, plan-printing, and disconnect diagnostics are disabled because they add instrumentation, formatting, or logging work to latency-sensitive transactions.
8. synchronous_commit and fsync are disabled to remove XLogFlush and commit-record latency identified in the profile; this is suitable only for a disposable benchmark because an operating-system or power failure can lose committed transactions and may leave the cluster unrecoverable.
9. A small nonzero commit_delay with commit_siblings set to seven permits limited commit grouping under 16-thread concurrency, although its effect is reduced while asynchronous commit is enabled.
10. max_wal_size is increased from 1024 MB to 4093 MB to reduce checkpoint frequency and associated buffer-lock and write pressure during the write-heavy benchmark.
11. cursor_tuple_fraction is kept low because OLTP cursors usually retrieve a small portion of their result, while the chosen value avoids repeating the previous configuration.
12. idle_in_transaction_session_timeout is made finite and nonzero to prevent abandoned transactions from retaining locks and snapshots, without interfering with normally progressing benchmark sessions.
13. All numeric recommendations use PostgreSQL native units, avoid the stated range boundaries, and use deliberately non-round values rather than repeating the prior configuration.
